coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value recall watch only. Production nationwide collector remains authoritative. No approvals, publication, schedule changes, or task disabling.

Twelve targeted searches completed without reported search failures: four sole/last/full-service grocery losses, three disaster-related emergency distribution disruptions, two abrupt food pantry/food bank service closures, three official SNAP/WIC/EBT interruptions.

No newly reported and independently verified qualifying United States food-access disruption since the previous confirmed heartbeat was found. Zero findings is not evidence of exhaustive coverage of provider social posts or unindexed county announcements.
Excluded Eastport, Maine's sole grocery store announcement from September 3, 2026; Ruby's Pantry Minnesota shutdown from April 1, 2026; and other earlier/foreign grocery incidents.

Excluded 2025 government shutdown SNAP notices (including the October 28, 2025 Arizona article and Massachusetts 2025 federal shutdown guidance). No new state-agency-confirmed SNAP/WIC interruption was established in the interval.
Excluded Kauaʻi's October 29, 2026 hurricane Lowell recovery resource listing because it did not establish a newly canceled emergency food distribution during this interval.
Unrelated food pantry openings, donation drives, resource guides, generic inflation stories, and other non-qualifying results were not treated as signals.
